title: Utah County Land Use Ordinance
notes: THE land-use / zoning code for unincorporated Utah County (a.k.a. UCLUO; formerly the Zoning Ordinance). Revised & adopted in its entirety with new Municode numbering/formatting by Ord. 2021-258 on 2021-04-09 (an earlier entire-recodification was Ord. 2020-1109); continuously amended since — latest captured Ord. 2026-383 (Impound Yards) 2026-06-09. Titles/chapters keyed by integer prefix (1 General Provisions, 2 Definitions/Land Use, 4 General Regulations, 6 Health/Hazards, 8 Special Uses, ... 16 Administration/Planning Commission). 132 sections. Amendment history embeds 303 adopted land-use ordinance numbers -> see adopted_ordinances.csv. Codified web book (not a stored PDF).

title: Utah County Code of Ordinances
notes: The general county Code of Ordinances (governance: administration, finance/budget, health, business licensing, public safety, animals, roads, etc.). 915 sections. Fewer amendment-history citations than the land ordinance (19 distinct ordinance numbers found). Codified web book. Growth-relevance: mostly low/indirect; use the Land Use Ordinance for zoning/development. No recodification date printed in the section text.

title: Utah County Policies
notes: County administrative/personnel policies (County Administration, HR, procurement, etc.). 74 sections. Included for completeness of the Municode host; NOT land-use / growth relevant and carries no ordinance-number amendment history. Codified web book.
